changelog:
- Opera-Style In-App Turbo Tunnel: Upgraded Fokk VPN with an enterprise-grade in-app TLS forwarder, eliminating public proxy drops and SSL handshake failures.
- Global Edge Regions: Added instant 1-tap switching between Americas, Europe, and Asia dedicated edge nodes.
- Custom Server Support: Users can configure and connect to their own private proxy/VPN server (host:port) with instant reachability diagnostics.
- Zero Latency Web Browsing: Flawless, full line-speed streaming and browsing for complex modern websites (Google, YouTube, etc.) with 100% IP masking.
